title: Vinegar-Soaked Middle Eastern Chicken Musakhan
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring juicy chicken, crispy onions, and a hint of lime juice. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the lardons to the skillet and cook until crispy, about 4 minutes
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside
Add the thinly sliced onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes
In a separate bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup of lime juice and 2 tablespoons of vinegar
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the skillet with the onion until browned on both sides, about 6 minutes
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and top with the crispy lardons and onion
Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot
Serve with a side of basmati rice or pita bread, if desired
